implementation.restart: Native group startup recovers complete owned promoted cells from authoritative replay even with stale learner configuration and deleted original learner storage. Incomplete owned targets retain configured read-only learner custody.
implementation.identity: Peer constructor rejects durable placement-group remapping and a promotion owner differing from authenticated local node. Local membership and mapped-endpoint checks remain required.
implementation.corruption: Missing or corrupt published pointers/owner metadata cannot downgrade to learner or initialize old-authority storage. Pending targets require matching node, group and original bootstrap.
implementation.elections: Declared timing still validates early; recovered voting membership also validates before listening. Recovered promoted cells with stale learner configuration cannot join automatic elections, including mixed-group daemons. Client learner restrictions remain.
implementation.admission: No new membership operator command, publication RPC or client/control admission is enabled.

regression_evidence.shrink_scope: One recorded host process outcome; replay preserves its exit-101 failure, not a deterministic native process schedule.

clippy.unrestricted_remaining: Existing dependency lints in rsf-tuple, rsf-manifest and rsf-prepared.

review.finding_fixed: Mixed-group election scheduling previously included recovered stale-learner promoted cells. Explicit voting configuration is now required and regression tested.

limits: Native peer publication quorum, live role handoff and atomic control/catalog admission remain unfinished.
Opaque pre-RSFC1 protocol payloads exercise native durability here; these role tests do not claim four-surface client admission after membership change.
Final source full gate, independent-group routing, retention/checkpoint/migration and independent-host/region numeric fault/capacity qualification remain required.
Recorded host processes and SIGKILL are not machine power-loss tests or deterministic socket/thread scheduling.
